items.headline: Heat Advisory issued July 7 at 2:38PM AKDT until July 10 at 12:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 85 degrees expected.

* WHERE...Central and Western Arctic Plains.

* WHEN...Until midnight AKDT Thursday night.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High temperatures up to 85 degrees during the
afternoons and evenings. The warmest temperatures are expected
between 4 PM and 11 PM AKDT.
items.areas: Western Arctic Plains; Central Arctic Plains
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.

Take extra precautions when working in the sun. Wear sunscreen and
lightweight, loose fitting clothing. Try to limit strenuous
activities to early morning or evening. Take action when you see
symptoms of heat exh

items.headline: Red Flag Warning issued July 7 at 8:42AM AKDT until July 8 at 12:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* AFFECTED AREA...Northern Seward Peninsula, Upper Kobuk Valleys
and Lower Koyukuk Valley.

* TIMING...For the Red Flag Warning, until midnight AKDT
tonight. For the Fire Weather Watch, from Wednesday morning
through Wednesday evening.

* THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE INDEX...Scattered.

* WINDS...Northeast 5 to 10 mph. Thunderstorm outflow winds could
reach 25 to 35 mph.

* HUMIDITY...25 to 35 percent.

* TEMPERATURES...Highs in the upper 70s/low 80s. Lows in the mid 40s.

* IMPACTS...Critical fire wea
items.areas: Northern Seward Peninsula; Upper Kobuk Valleys; Lower Koyukuk Valley
items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that conditions are occurring or will
occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the
field of this Red Flag Warning.

items.headline: Fire Weather Watch issued July 7 at 8:42AM AKDT until July 9 at 12:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* AFFECTED AREA...Lower Kobuk Valley.

* TIMING...From Wednesday morning through Wednesday evening.

* THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE INDEX...Isolated to Scattered

* WINDS...West 10 to 15 mph.

* HUMIDITY...35 to 45 percent.

* TEMPERATURES...Highs around 80. Lows in the upper 40s.

* IMPACTS...Critical fire weather conditions are possible due to
scattered thunderstorms. Thunderstorms will come with frequent
lightning and outflow boundaries. Any lightning can cause new
ignitions since the fuels are dry
items.instruction:
A Fire Weather Watch means that weather conditions could lead to
the potential for a Red Flag event in the near future. This watch
will remain in effect until it is upgraded to a Red Flag Warning
or that it is determined that the Red Flag event will not
develop.
